text:
maria: Weekly account health check — focusing on token usage + throughput (WoW/QoQ) for Lumina onboarding. Quick highlights: tokens +52% WoW, +18% QoQ; p50 latency +120ms WoW; error rate 0.4% but a 1.7% spike around 03/18 10:05 UTC. Anyone see infra or enablement changes?
keisha: FYI enablement ran a new prompt bundle last Wed (A/B of canonical vs expanded prompts) — that likely explains the token jump. I sent the prompt diffs to analytics.
ben: Telemetry: pattern is bursty in short windows 10:00–10:08 UTC daily, low batching efficiency. Throughput per GPU down ~14% during bursts. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/lumina-throughput (check route /generate)
analytics-bot: weekly_summary: tokens_by_route.csv available in the BI bucket. Top contributor: `user_prompt_v2` (63% of added tokens).
nasir: Ops side — no Lumina service deploys from infra last week. We did increase queue limit for dedicated pool (for partner X) on 03/17 but that didn't target Lumina. No autoscale changes for their capacity.
deploy-bot: deploy: service/lumina-backend v3.4.1 deployed 2025-03-17 09:23 UTC by jdoe
maria: Noted. Renewal risk flag: their spend jumped ~62% MoM due to token growth. If we don't reduce unit cost or adjust quotas they may hit an overage and pause. Need cost mitigation plan + customer-facing note.
keisha: I'll book a cost review + enablement review with Lumina for Thu 15:00 PT. Also prepping a short explainer: caching, batching, prompt hygiene.
ben: Quick ops suggestion — enable prefix KV caching for repeated prefixes, estimate ~28% token savings on current traffic. Also increase batching window during bursts to improve throughput.
maria: Ben/Nasir — can you prototype caching toggle for Lumina in staging and share perf numbers before Thu? Keisha — I'll draft renewal note and invite finance.
ben: On it. I'll run a 2h A/B in staging tomorrow and post numbers here.
keisha: Assigned action items to Lumina CSM in Asana. Will update the thread with the meeting link and prep doc.
maria: Thanks all. I'll follow up with WoW vs QoQ charts after Ben's numbers. If caching yields >20% savings we can present an immediate remediation plan to reduce renewal risk. :thumbsup:
